purpose: diagnose observability of fixed endpoint rests and their immediate preceding charge/discharge; no replacement capacity prediction
design_usage: all four labels/predictions and 2019 detailed curves already seen; retrospective diagnosis, not independent validation

information.embargo_basis: conservative engineering assumption inspired by author average preparation/test/follow-up of about two days; actual prep onset unknown
information.available_time_assumption: all included native rows are retrospectively available by history cutoff; no actual reception logs
information.timezone: native source strings only; absolute timezone not assumed
information.isolation: rows at or after cutoff, including test/preparation, excluded from feature computation; labels joined after selection

reference.status: author-reported controlled field DC usable quantities; shared measurement chain, not VPP commitment truth
reference.numbers_role: labels only, not used to pick history, anchors or candidate intervals

endpoints: exact high and low rests of each event selected in existing features.csv/pairs.csv; 8 fixed endpoints; never reselect
raw_window: existing fixed history only; never read beyond cutoff or bridge a native timestamp gap
quality: finite recorded fields and Interpolated=0; invalid/time gap resets; retain censoring and failures rather than fill
rest_rule: existing abs I <=0.15 A; describe full observed rest containing frozen anchor, its duration/start/end, U first/anchor/last, last-60-second range at frozen anchor; no fitted equilibrium voltage
preceding_activity: scan backward from rest start within the same original native block through consecutive finite noninterpolated rows with abs I >0.15 A, stopping at preceding rest/gap/quality boundary; end exclusive at rest start
preceding_direction: report charge/discharge seconds and gross charge/gross discharge/signed net Ah separately, mixed direction retained; no dominant-direction label or SOC conversion
preceding_integration: only diagnostic throughput: native one-second left rectangles on the fixed contiguous activity rows; not usable capacity prediction
censoring: record whether preceding activity onset is observed after a valid rest row, or only bounded by history/block/quality boundary; do not call censored event complete
not_allowed: changing old voltage/rest thresholds or selection
20 percent SOC cutoff inferred from nominal capacity
deleting failed events or replacing published references
expected_output: all 8 endpoint contexts or explicit unavailable reasons; raw/source/protocol/code fingerprints and independent verification before interpretation
